findings.text: The company was incorporated on 30 September 2024 and its status is recorded as active, with a proposal to strike off.
The accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due 30 June 2026 and no last made-up date recorded.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 10 September 2025 and the next is due 24 September 2026.
There is one current officer, a director, PERSON 257, appointed on 30 September 2024.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 258, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
No other appointments were found for the director, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 296 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement.
